start_command: cd backend && uv run uvicorn telemed.api.app:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
start_note: npm start does not exist in group A (created by E5-S1); start the backend directly with uvicorn and capture stdout/stderr to a file for log checks.

api_checks.note: AC1 startup timing: launch uvicorn, poll /health; first 200 must arrive within 1s of the process listening
valid non-UUID value matching ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$ is echoed
65-character otherwise-valid value is invalid and replaced by a UUID
header present on error responses too

live log check: send POST /health with X-Request-ID=log-check-1 and JSON body {"email":"phi.person@example.test","full_name":"Zebediah Quillfeather","text":"secret note text 9137"}; then read captured uvicorn stdout. Every non-empty log line parses as JSON, lines for the request contain correlation_id == log-check-1, and none of the email, name or note text appears anywhere in the log output.
api_checks.expect: all lines valid JSON; correlation_id present; zero PHI substrings

api_checks.note: 409 for SlotUnavailableException and InvalidAppointmentStateException, 422 for naive datetime and malformed input, 503 with generic body on SQLite lock timeout

cd backend && uv run pytest tests/architecture/test_no_phi_in_logs.py -q

api_checks.note: every new connection: journal_mode wal, busy_timeout >= 5000
bad slot/appointment status rejected by CHECK

fresh empty sqlite file: uv run alembic upgrade head, then SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' must include users, patient_profiles, patient_profile_versions, doctor_profiles, availability_templates, slots, appointments, appointment_events, consultation_notes
independent of pytest: on the alembic-migrated DB insert a row into each of the three append-only tables, run UPDATE and DELETE via sqlite3, expect an error each time and row unchanged
